hero.subtitle: Authorization Code Exchange for web and mobile — Twitch Developer Console setup, API reference, and frontend examples.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Twitch login is optional and controlled by TWITCH_AUTH_ENABLED. When disabled, Twitch endpoints return 503 Service Unavailable. JWTs are never placed in the redirect URL; the API issues a one-time exchangeCode (Redis, 60 seconds). The same POST /auth/exchange endpoint is shared with other social providers.
items: Profile fetched via GET https://api.twitch.tv/helix/users after token exchange (Authorization: Bearer + Client-Id)
Scope user:read:email for profile and email
Same token response shape as POST /auth/login

console.title: Twitch Developer Console
console.description: Register an application under Twitch Developer Console → Applications → Register Your Application and set the OAuth Redirect URL to match TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL. Enable the user:read:email scope.
steps: Enter a name and OAuth Redirect URL (e.g. http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/twitch/callback)
Select a category and confirm the application
Copy Client ID and generate a Client Secret
Ensure TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL matches the OAuth Redirect URL registered in Twitch
Request the user:read:email scope during authorization

env.title: Environment variables
env.description: Loaded from .env via src/config/twitch-oauth.config.ts (namespace twitchOAuth on ConfigService). See .env.example.

roles.title: Default roles for new Twitch users
roles.description: New Twitch users receive roles: [] by default (same as password register). Set TWITCH_OAUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES in .env to a comma-separated list of Role values (e.g. user or user,manager). Existing users linked by email keep their current roles.

flow.title: Sequence
items: User consents on Twitch; browser hits GET /api/v1/auth/twitch/callback
API calls GET https://api.twitch.tv/helix/users, upserts user, stores exchangeCode in Redis, redirects to redirect?code=...
Client POSTs { code } to /api/v1/auth/exchange and receives JWTs

start.title: 1. Start OAuth
start.description: Opens Twitch consent at https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/authorize. Query redirect must match a prefix in TWITCH_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (or omit to use the first allowlist entry). Scope: user:read:email.

callback.title: 2. Callback
callback.description: Handled by the API. Token exchange uses https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token. Redirects to your app with ?code= (or &code= if the URL already has a query).

exchange.title: 3. Exchange code
exchange.description: Public endpoint shared with other social providers. Consumes the code (single use) and returns the same shape as login.

web.title: Frontend — Web (SPA)
web.description: Typical flow: button starts OAuth in the same window (or popup); a callback route on your frontend origin reads code from the query string and calls exchange.
notes: Add your frontend callback URL to TWITCH_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (e.g. http://localhost:5173/auth/callback)
TWITCH_CALLBACK_URL must point at the Nest API, not the SPA
Store accessToken / refreshToken securely (memory + httpOnly cookie patterns as you prefer)

mobile.title: Frontend — Mobile (deep link)
mobile.description: Use a custom scheme (or universal link) in the allowlist. After Twitch, the API redirects to myapp://success?code=.... The app opens, parses the code, and calls exchange.
notes: Register the scheme in the OS / Expo app.json
Exchange over HTTPS against your API base URL

security.title: Security notes
items: Redirect URLs must match TWITCH_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST prefixes
Exchange codes are single-use and expire in 60 seconds (Redis)
Existing local users are linked by verified Twitch email (twitchId set; roles unchanged)
Twitch-only users have password null — password login / change-password will fail until a password is set
Email is required from api.twitch.tv/helix/users; login fails if Twitch does not return an email (scope user:read:email)

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: Postgres entity / interface fields used by Twitch login:
items: twitchId — unique nullable Twitch user id (id from Helix /users)
isActive — set true for new Twitch users
